_doc: STAGING. HBCU and Homecoming MERGED, on the game wing's recommendation that they are the same weekend and because separately each was starving — 8 candidates and 7, with bases like MORBID and NIMROD offered for the yard. Together: 22. The cultural bench's caution governs the selection: shako, plume and drumline must not become the whole pack, or the game has published 'HBCU = marching band'. Four of these nine boards are the band or the parade; the other five are Greek life, the dorm, graduation and the clothes.

theme.name: Homecoming Weekend
theme.blurb: The band, the yard, the stroll and the step show — and the graduates who drove six hours to stand in the same spot.

boards.scene: Where everybody stays, and nobody sleeps

clues.hostel: What the block ends up being, four to a room, booked in February

clues.stole: Over the shoulder, letters showing, ironed on the bed at seven in the morning
clues.lost: The room key, twice, by the same cousin who drove
clues.shoe: The other one, under the bed, and the shuttle leaves in four minutes

clues.won: The vote was in October and the margin is still being discussed
clues.sign: Held up in the third row by people who have been up since five

clues.dean: Signs off on all of it, and knows more than the paperwork says
clues.line: Numbered, in order, and the order does not change for the rest of your life
clues.lined: Up the same way at every show, because that is how you learned it
clues.aide: The one from the chapter above who checked on you at two in the morning
clues.idea: What it was in September, before anybody understood the hours

clues.lost: The route sheet, which is why the second half improvises
clues.alto: The horn line that carries the melody once the trumpets tire
clues.flat: What the sousaphone is by the fourth mile, and the crowd does not care

clues.camped: What you did in the lounge for three days because the room was not ready
clues.mace: Carried at the front of the procession, and older than everyone holding it
clues.made: What people ask if you did, and the answer changes the conversation
clues.cape: Somebody's, from the show, hanging on the back of a chair
clues.came: The whole family, in two cars, and stayed longer than anyone wanted
clues.acme: The dining hall's finest hour, which is a fried chicken Wednesday

boards.scene: Graduation morning, and who is in the stands

clues.barged: How your people get to the front, and no usher has ever stopped them
clues.grad: Four years, or six, and the cap says which in glitter
clues.badge: The parking pass on the dash that got three cars in on one
clues.brag: What the whole row has earned the right to do, loudly, during your name
clues.gear: In the trunk since Thursday, because nobody was driving back twice

boards.scene: The yard between classes, in April

clues.yard: The whole institution in one word, and it is a lawn
clues.made: The question again, asked across the quad, by somebody you barely know
clues.year: Counted in homecomings rather than semesters, by everyone who left
clues.dear: How the letters are addressed when the alumni office wants money
clues.army: What the band becomes at eight in the morning on the practice field

boards.scene: What you packed, and what you actually wore

clues.closet: Emptied into a bag on Wednesday for a weekend that needs four outfits

clues.cost: Of the weekend, tallied on the drive home, and worth it
